source_en: So. You are the replacement.
You look exactly like the last one. Same uniform, same nervous eyes.
Same face that says I have no idea what I agreed to. Good. That means you are normal. {{For now}}.
My name is Vladislav Syrnikov. You will call me Vlad.
Outside this booth, you will not say that name. This is not vanity. It is simply how things are.
Tell me. What do you know about what comes through this gate?
Civilians, migrants, documented travelers.
Mm. The paperwork version. Cute. You are going to have a very interesting first week.
Whatever the briefing didn't cover, I assume.
Ha! I like that. Pessimism and self-awareness. You may survive after all. Do not get comfortable.
Most of what you will see is boring. Papers, stamps, faces, send them through.
You will wish for something to happen. Do not. The boring days are the gift.
When something wrong walks through that window, and it will, what is your instinct?
Follow the rulebook. Document everything.
The rulebook. Yes. Good friend, the rulebook.
Until it has never seen what you are looking at. Then it is useless paper.
Trust my gut. Make a call.
Your gut. Good. Your gut will be smarter than you, most of the time.
The times it is not, those are the times that end careers. Or worse.
There are things coming through this gate that your training did not cover.
When you encounter one, do not panic. Do your job. The [[paperwork will lie]]. The face might lie.
But something about them will feel wrong. Trust that.
You have questions. I can see them. Keep them for now.
Do your job, stay sharp, and if you last the week, maybe I answer some of them.
Try not to disappoint me, Officer. It would be genuinely inconvenient.
